gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: DeSmuME .dsv: 512 KiB raw and the 122-byte footer (size 524288, padSize 524288, type 0 (Autodetect), addr_size 3, mem_size 0)

rom.name: Pokemon - HeartGold Version (USA).nds
rom.note: a dump of this game code whose sha1 is not in the No-Intro DAT (the area after the used ROM size is blank); the region in the name is a guess

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-dsv.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - HeartGold Version (USA)' --out DIR: cuts the DeSmuME footer; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
